description: This Java class defines the data structure 'ProvisioningEntryData' used for provisioning entries within the accounting provisioning module of the Fineract project. It includes metadata annotations and various fields relevant to provisioning entries, such as identifiers, user info, date, amount, and associated provisioning entries.

classes.name: ProvisioningEntryData
classes.description: A data class representing provisioning entry details used in accounting provisioning processes. It is serializable and uses Lombok annotations to generate boilerplate code. Contains identifiers, user info, date, amount, and related provisioning entries.
